newsitem.title: USA: Cellegy names Michael Forrest as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Cellegy names Michael Forrest as CEO.

text.p: Cellegy Pharmaceuticals Inc said it named Michael Forrest, 53, to the positions of president and chief executive officer.
Forrest will replace Cellegy co-founder and chairman Carl Thornfeldt, who has served as acting president and chief executive officer since July. Thornfeldt will remain as chairman.

Since 1991 Forrest has served as president and chief executive at two biotech firms, most recently at Mercator Genetics in Menlo Park, Calif., and previously at Transkaryotic Therapies Inc, a gene-activation company in Cambridge, Mass.
